dedupe_keys.name: kartaview formerly openstreetcam open street level imagery

description: KartaView, formerly OpenStreetCam and OpenStreetView, is a platform for collecting and providing free and open street-level imagery, with a website, Android and iOS apps, uploading tools and a map editor. According to the OpenStreetMap wiki it was built by Telenav, transferred to Grab in December 2019, and publishes images under CC BY-SA, with a proprietary server backend and apps; the wiki lists app versions released in May 2024. Its imagery is one of the two sources, with Mapillary, of the NUS Global Streetscapes dataset of 10 million images. Coverage: worldwide where contributors have captured imagery. Access: free web map and apps. Licence: CC BY-SA images. Caveats: the provider site loads only with scripts and could not be read here, so facts come from the OpenStreetMap wiki and the Global Streetscapes project; coverage is uneven. Simulation uses are street and public space inventories and building facade observations for exposure and urban design studies. Related records: Mapillary and NUS Global Streetscapes.
